voice.name: Open Sector - Borg Drone
voice.note: Shares the Borg Drone voice (voices/borgdrone.json): the account holds more than 20 custom voices, all in use, so no new one is designed. A little looser and hungrier than the plain drone.
voice.description: A thin, flat, hollow chorus of many young androgynous voices speaking the same words in perfect unison, like a single drone of an alien cyborg hive: lighter and younger than a commander, emotionless and obedient, airy and slightly metallic with a faint electronic buzz and a hollow tube-like resonance, quick clipped machine cadence, no personality of its own.

fire.prompt: A creature spitting acid: a short wet throaty hork and gurgle, a forceful wet spit of a thick glob, then a splat on metal with a hissing corrosive acid sizzle eating into it, close, outdoors, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Steady rhythmic walking footsteps of a heavy wet organic cyborg creature, left right left right, six squelching heavy footfalls in mud with slimy wet slaps and a faint servo whir between steps, spread evenly over two seconds, close, no music, no voice
